title.narrative: Climate Innovations for Resilience in Karamoja and Kyangwali (CLIRK)

description.narrative: The projected supported sustainable changes for refugees and host community members through the transfer of knowledge on regenerative and innovative gardening techniques. CARE and partners facilitated local uptake of promoted solutions using demonstration sites for testing and conducted training of trainers for Agricultural Extension Services. Finally the project supported households by distributing seeds, starter kits, micro greens and vertical garden setups.

activity-date.narrative: Aligned with closing of overall grant (SPA with Danish MFA)
